data.hypothesis: A 24-target-warp CTA may retain the lower CTA count that helped the correct 16-warp candidate while avoiding the larger CTA size of the slower 32-warp candidate. Its occupancy and timing effects remain to be measured.
data.notes: This changes launch geometry only. The existing kernel assigns one target to each warp, derives warps per CTA from blockDim, reduces all three force components, skips self pairs, softens coincident positions, and writes the complete Particle from lane 0. The new configuration keeps items_per_block equal to block/32 and uses no shared memory. Recorded correct candidates measured about 0.0001174 s at 16 warps, 0.0001601 s at 32, and 0.0001528 s for the selected 8-warp parent; no measurement or correctness claim is made for this candidate. The controller should run correctness checks before timing.
transformations: Set the CTA size to 768 threads (24 warps) and items_per_block to 24, preserving the existing one-warp-per-target kernel mapping and zero shared-memory allocation.
